text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- ETA arsenal found in Durango (Vizcaya). It was occupied by a command.
- Herri Batasuna's hard core animate ETA to pursue terrorist campaign
EL MUNDO
- (Basque police) Ertzaintza discover ETA "factory" with 30 kilos of explosive.
- ETA's victims ask that the response to them not be by the same means.
LA VANGUARDIA
- An explosion allows the discovery of ETA arsenal in Durango.
- (Parti per la Independencia's leader) Rahola leaves unclear if it will back Clos as Barcelona's mayor to substitute Maragall in September.
CINCO DIAS
- JP Morgan's raid in (Madrid) Bourse
- Telefonica and MCI launch with three firms their pan-american network.
- Five saving banks offer 20 billion pesetas for a 20 percent stake in Ebro Agricolas.
- Backbone of PP's tax reform
EXPANSION
- New income tax will have maximum rate reduced at least to 50 percent (now at 56 pct).
- Public investment to rise seven percent in 1998
- Half a million personal investors entered in the (Spanish) stock market via investment trusts.
- Planet Hollywood to open Madrid restaurant
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Spanish state will save 1.7 trillion thanks to lower interest rates (when the reductions affect all outstanding public debt)
- The government will approve Endesa's public offer next week.
- (Industry Minister) Pique confirms electricity tariffs will be reduced more than two percent in 1998
- From 1999, highest tax income rate will be lower than 50 percent
